title: The move costs about $27,700 once and saves about $2,700 per month
summary: The estimate covers 31 engineer-days and 6 weeks of staging. Approve a one-time budget of $30,000, which includes a buffer of about 8%.

blocks.title: What we estimated
blocks.html:
• [INFERRED] The one-time cost is about $27,700. Engineering is about 90% of it. [src: report.md]
  • [READ] The running cost goes from $7,000 to $4,300 per month, from the provider price list. The extended support fee for MySQL 5.7 stops. [src: report.md]
  • [INFERRED] The saving is $2,700 per month. Payback takes about 10 months.

blocks.title: What is not certain
blocks.html:
• [UNVERIFIED] The price list does not show a contract discount for the shop.
  • [INFERRED] The engineering days come from the effort of each finding. The largest items are F5 (8 days) and F6 (6.5 days).
  • The rollback window (D3) adds about $137 per day while MySQL runs.

blocks.title: Proposed action
blocks.html: Approve a one-time budget of $30,000. If the cost goes above $27,700, I will tell you before I spend the buffer.
